comment: Sovereign Router v0.5 starting model set, exactly per spec v0.5.3 'Starting model set' table. No API keys here — provider keys live as mode-600 files in the state dir (keys/<provider>.key). spend_alert_usd is an alert level, never a cap. v0.5.5 (2026-11-07): rescue_eligible removed from premium/gpt-5.5 — the free-first / paid-spillway waterfall in the gateway supersedes the v0.5.3 rescue pin (owner ruling 2026-11-07). v0.5.6 (2026-11-07): SiliconFlow added — siliconflow/glm-5.3 ENABLED in the paid lane at half of Z.ai direct (NON-SENSITIVE ONLY, spillway_sensitive_excluded) and siliconflow/deepseek-v4-pro present but DISABLED; gateway v0.5.6 enforces the per-model sensitive exclusion in every pass.

models.notes: Spec: quality 2, small prompts only — Groq free tier is 8k tokens/min per model, so the tpm limit makes the router skip it for large (e.g. Hermes) prompts instead of waiting.
Spec: quality 4, small prompts only (8k tokens/min Groq free limit).
Spec registry name qwen3.8-27b (v0.3 registry.json spelling); quality 3, small prompts only.

Spec: private-free only because data_collection=deny is enforced via extra_body on every call. About 1,000 requests/day shared across clients (rpd). Code quality seeded 4 (it is a code model); other classes at the spec's flat 3. 2026-11-04: reasoning disabled via extra_body - direct probes showed this endpoint's hidden reasoning expands to consume ANY budget (512-8192) on most code prompts, returning finish=length with zero content; OpenRouter ignores reasoning.max_tokens and effort caps for it but honours reasoning.enabled=false, after which it answers directly.
Spec: preview model, re-probe weekly. 512k context makes it the long-context free option (long-context quality seeded 4); other classes at the spec's flat 3.

Spec: $0.09/$0.18 per 1M, 262k configured context, quality '4 to 5' — seeded 5 for infra/code (its proven v0.3.3 canary work) and 4 elsewhere. Cached input billed at 20% ($0.018/1M). Spend alert $10/month, no cap.

Spec: $0.15/$0.60 per 1M, quality 4, spend alert $5/month (no cap). Daily token limit matches the Ollama Cloud plan behaviour observed 2026-10-31 (400k/day exhausted by 17 Hermes turns); rpd/rpm to be set from the plan page at deploy time.

SiliconFlow (international, api.siliconflow.com) serving Z.ai's GLM-5.3 — the like-for-like probe's one clear price win (2026-11-07): exactly half of Z.ai direct on every component ($0.70 in / $0.13 cached / $2.20 out vs $1.40 / $0.26 / $4.40). Quality mirrored from zai/glm-5.3 (same model). NON-SENSITIVE ONLY: spillway_sensitive_excluded — SF's data posture graded UNCLEAR (training not contractually prohibited, retention unspecified, no ZDR/DPA), so the gateway never selects this entry for sensitive turns in any pass. Limits are SF's L0 (new-account) ceilings: 1,000 RPM / 40,000 TPM per account and model — a ~45k-token turn exceeds the TPM window and skips to DeepInfra by design; raise the limits as the account tier rises with spend. Prices read from OpenRouter's live SF endpoints and corroborated by two aggregators (SF's own pricing page is JS-rendered); confirm firsthand once the account key lands — checklist in the deploy record. Key file keys/siliconflow.key via the capture page; deployed keyless 2026-11-07 (skipped as provider_key_missing until the key lands).

Premium lane placeholder carried from v0.2.1 production (gpt-5.5 was 82 of the 104 premium requests in the live audit; claude-sonnet-4-6 took the rest and can be added as a second premium entry before Phase 3). PRICING IS A PLACEHOLDER — confirm against the provider price list before Phase 3; the premium monthly alert ($20 proposed) lives on the OpenClaw client policy. Only level 5 or explicit premium, only for clients with premium permission.

Direct DeepSeek (bypasses DeepInfra). Accounting at PEAK rates ($1.32 in / $0.044 cached / $3.96 out); off-peak (most of the MT day) is exactly half ($0.66 / $0.022 / $1.98). Peak windows 01:00-04:00 and 06:00-10:00 UTC weekdays. Quality: reasoning 5 (HLE #8, 60.0%); code/infra 5 (V4 family already carries 5/5 in this registry via DeepInfra canary work); chat/long-context 4 (strong but not the fleet's proven classes). Key file keys/deepseek.key via the capture page. v0.5.5 (2026-11-07): the owner replaced the gpt-5.5-only rescue pin with the free-first / paid spillway — as a premium entry this model is reachable in the spillway pass in normal cost order.

Direct Z.ai pay-as-you-go (NOT the GLM Coding Plan, which is tool-restricted). Base path is /api/paas/v4 — /v1 returns 404 on this platform. Quality: reasoning 5 (HLE #6, 62.5%, best of the three newcomers); code 5 (GLM flagship coding line); chat/infra/long-context 4 (1M context, capable, but unproven in this fleet — raise from probe data). Latency seeded high: infra is primarily in China. Key file keys/zai.key via the capture page. v0.5.5 (2026-11-07): the owner replaced the gpt-5.5-only rescue pin with the free-first / paid spillway — as a premium entry this model is reachable in the spillway pass in normal cost order.

SiliconFlow serving DeepSeek V4 Pro — a second host for the premium step (probe 2026-11-07: output $1.50 beats DeepSeek direct off-peak $1.98; cache $0.135 is ~6x DeepSeek direct's off-peak $0.022, so it would win output-heavy turns only). DEPLOYED DISABLED (the Muse Spark pattern): enable only after the with-key checklist settles its price firsthand — SF's own model page suggests $1.50/$3.135 for this model ID vs the probe's $1.00/$1.50 OpenRouter read. NON-SENSITIVE ONLY: spillway_sensitive_excluded, same posture basis as siliconflow/glm-5.3. Limits are SF's L0 ceilings (1,000 RPM / 40,000 TPM). Quality mirrored from deepseek/deepseek-v4-pro (same model).

Meta Model API, STANDARD tier only (contributor tier lets Meta train on traffic; 1.1 has no contributor variant). Quality: reasoning 5 (HLE #7, 62.1%); chat 5 (Meta's flagship assistant model); code/infra/long-context 4. context_tokens 262144 is a SEED — UNVERIFIED, confirm against Meta's docs in the probe battery before enabling. Documented team limits 3,000 RPM / 4M TPM (not enforced in limits until deploy decision). DEPLOYED DISABLED 2026-11-05: the account key verifies (GET /v1/models 200) but chat returns 402 billing_not_configured until Jordan resolves the Meta team billing issue at dev.meta.ai — enable only after billing clears AND the probe battery passes. Key file keys/meta.key via the capture page. v0.5.5 (2026-11-07): the owner replaced the gpt-5.5-only rescue pin with the free-first / paid spillway — as a premium entry this model is reachable in the spillway pass in normal cost order.
